segments.name: North America Exploration and Production
segments.description: Exploration, development, production, and marketing of crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas in North America.
segments.evidence: The Company's exploration and production activities are conducted in three geographic segments: North America, North Sea and Offshore Africa.

segments.name: Offshore Africa Exploration and Production
segments.description: Exploration, development, production, and marketing of crude oil, natural gas liquids, and natural gas offshore Africa.
segments.evidence: The Company's exploration and production activities are conducted in three geographic segments: North America, North Sea and Offshore Africa.

segments.name: Oil Sands Mining and Upgrading
segments.description: Oil sands mining and upgrading activities reported separately from exploration and production.
segments.evidence: The Company's Oil Sands Mining and Upgrading activities are reported in a separate segment from exploration and production activities.

segments.name: Midstream and Refining
segments.description: Pipeline operations, an electricity co-generation system, and North West Redwater Partnership.
segments.evidence: Midstream and Refining activities include the Company's pipeline operations, an electricity co-generation system, and NWRP.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for crude oil, natural gas liquids and natural gas sold to external customers based on the location of the seller.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales to external customers are based on the location of the seller.
